mapper.sql: id, username, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, u.status, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM user_identity i INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.user_id WHERE i.identity_type = #{identityType} AND i.identity_value = #{identityValue} AND i.verified_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (id, username, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{userId}
